data.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'Awsah'. It means 'Bright, Radiant'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes enlightenment and wisdom. The name Awshan carries the meaning “Bright, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awshan usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's 'The Muqaddimah' mentions Awshan ibn al-Qass as a Berber chief who ruled over Bijaya (Annaba, Algeria) from 1337 to 1342.
Al-Maqrizi in 'Kitab al-Mawāʿiẓ wa-l-Ḳīṭāṭ' records Awshan as a Berber ruler of Tunis from 1472 to 1474, during the Hafsid Dynasty.
